name: s7-first-grid
note: The first S7 grid (2026-10-22): six knobs that the lanes changed one sibling at a time, over the S7 default, subsampled (seeded: n 110 first, 28 min with --jobs 3, then resumed to n 220, the first 110 being the same configs); the evidence scoring is crossed with every kept config, because its twin shares the sequencing's cells and costs only the final ranking.
